Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<cstdio>
#include<vector>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> getRow(int rowIndex) {
        int numRows = rowIndex + 1;
        vector<vector<int>> rows(numRows);

        if (numRows > 0) rows[0] = {1};
        for (int i = 1; i < numRows; i++)
        {
            vector<int> row(i+1);         // 第 i 行 (行index为i-1) 有 i 个数
            auto preRow = rows[i-1];
            auto curRow = row;

            curRow[0] = curRow[i] = 1;

            for (int j = 1; j < curRow.size() - 1; j++)  // 每一行的首尾两个数不是通过相加得来的
            {
                curRow[j] = preRow[j-1] + preRow[j];
            }
            rows[i] = curRow;            
        }
        return rows[rowIndex];
    }
};

// Below is testing
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int numRows = 5;
    auto res = sol.getRow(numRows);

    for (int i = 0; i < res.size(); i++)
        printf("%d ", res[i]);     

    return 0;
}
